description: Where a change in a count sits: by search, page, topic, device, channel or event, each group's change and share of the total, biggest first. Not whether it is beyond noise (webops_compare) or why. Another organization's or an unconnected site answers not found. Read-only.

after_from.description: First day of the later window.

after_to.description: Last day of the later window (same length as the earlier one).

before_from.description: Instead of days: first day of the earlier window (give all four).

before_to.description: Last day of the earlier window.

by.description: query, page, topic, device, channel or event (country and search_feature answer that they are not held).

channel.description: An Analytics channel, e.g. Organic Search, Direct.

limit.description: How many groups (default 10); the rest are summed.

metric.description: A count: clicks, impressions, sessions, engaged_sessions or conversions.

page.description: One page, exactly as webops_pages returns it.

query.description: One search, as webops_searches returns it.

topic.description: A topic in a few words: the searches sharing its topic words.

name: webops_breakdown
title: Where a change sits
